callback_implementation_obligation: Both concrete and symbolic evaluators reject FnOpDynamic. symbolic_fun_call_inst.call_kind and SymbolicAst.call_id.Fun identify regular fn_ptr_kind only. Existing signature decomposition depends on per-declaration effect information. A supported symbolic indirect call must carry the actual evaluated callback value and its signature/effects, instantiate locally bound callback lifetimes, retain borrow abstractions/backward outputs and generate an application of that value. Inventing a function declaration ID or translating only the forward unit result would lose required information.
callback_value_obligation: Actual execute copies self.fn_ field zero to local3, moves original ctx local2 to local4, dynamically calls moved local3 with moved local4 and writes unit result to local0. Both stored and evaluated callback types equal the original FnPtr, with H/WIRE/component type arguments [1,0,2..9] and one locally bound lifetime for two mutable Context fields. Origin and binding audit is not an operational semantics or compiler proof.
